text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later,
I go to the cafeteria for
my break and happen to see
Kawakami
Princess's two friends.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't you think we should stop her?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You're right... That's simply too much.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I glance over to where the two are looking
and see Kawakami
Princess. It seems like
she's just relaxing with some tea...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ergh...
Why're these little teacups so hard
to hold? It's making my...
fingers tired...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ouch, that's hot! It's okay, just need to
stay calm...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hooohohoho, there's nothing more
princess-like than enjoying a nice
cup of
tea in the afternoon!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
This is weird.
She wasn't always like this,
right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, she's on her twentieth cup of tea.
That much can't be good for
the body...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And she used to eat big, heaping plates of
food. Now she barely eats
at all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I think she was saying that princesses are
too elegant to eat more
than a handful of
anything.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that! She's elegant! That's what
really makes a
princess—elegance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She admires King Halo's refined manners,
but from what her friends
are saying, she
might be taking things a little too far.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Aaagh! Kawakami disappeared while we
were standing here yappin'!
Where'd she
go?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, who knows? We've got practice to get
to, so let's have a talk with
her later.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two move on with their day, but I'm
starting to get more worried
than them.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Urrrp... My stomach's about to burst...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I can't let a little hardship get me
down! This is all part of a
princess's
mission—for elegance!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Erk... Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Gah! Y-you've got it all wrong—I didn't
puke! I managed to keep it
down!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wait, is that you, Trainer? Hello there... Ungh. Isn't it a nice day?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
P-push myself? I'm just taking a nice,
elegant walk, as princesses do.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Try to be? W-wait, don't tell me you know!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You know I'm training myself to be
elegant?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry for losing my cool. I had no
idea anyone would be able to
tell I was
practicing.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course, to act in the proper,
dignified manner of a princess.
You know,
cause princesses have to be all graceful
and elegant.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I hit the nail on the head, but
Kawakami suddenly seems
disappointed.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm so shocked someone found out... But
you're right. I was practicing
so I could
become like King.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I've always looked up to how strong
Princess Fighter is. Once I came
to the
academy though, I met King Halo, and...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I realized a princess needs to be refined
and graceful, like her! That's
why I'm going
to follow her example, and—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Well, like,
she never goes up stairs two at
a time, or chugs down fizzy
drinks, or eats
from a giant bowl of food...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's going... Actually,
it's not going well at
all. I don't feel even a tiny
bit like her.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The tryouts are already coming up, but I
wonder if someone like me
can really
become a princess before then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see what she's worried about, but I'm
starting to think it might not
be the best
for her. How do I tell her that though?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Go see King? But I've already
watched her a whole bunch.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you say so, I guess it might be
good.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Exhale... Hup!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah! She really is wonderful!
Just look at
that dignified form—that
graceful
movement!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Only King could run so elegantly!
It's what
a princess should be... Ah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crash!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I'm not done yet!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wow... She fell, but she's still going,
even
all covered in mud. How
noble, how
beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Of course she does! She's determined to
go as far as it takes to be
first-rate!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
She has an unshakable ideal, no matter
what other people might
think! That's why
she's a bright, shining example of—oh.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I get it... The thing that makes her so
dignified comes from the inside.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That's why it was so hard for me.
If I just
copy how she moves, I'm still
empty on the
inside...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's strange to see her this sad...
Does she
really think she's empty
inside?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's my dream—I'm the one who decides it,
and I'm the one who will
achieve it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She knew exactly what her dream was
back then.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Really? You mean I don't just have to copy
Princess Fighter or King
Halo?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You're... right.
I still have time before the
tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess nods along, though she
still seems uneasy
watching King Halo.
